mug_priya: Pattern: I incorrectly assumed it moved to the bedroom nightstand early in the day. Reality: It remained at kitchen_table_k1 at 07:32. It frequently shifts between kitchen_table_k1 and coffee_table_l1. Next time: Check kitchen_table_k1 first in the morning; do not assume bedroom movement without specific evidence.

glass_priya: Pattern: I failed to track its mid-day and late-evening locations, defaulting to sink_k1 or kitchen_table_k1. Reality: It was at counter_k1 at 17:48 and coffee_table_l1 at 22:39. It moves to the living room in the evening. Next time: Check counter_k1 for afternoon queries and coffee_table_l1 for late evening queries. Avoid sink_k1 unless washing is confirmed.

water_bottle_priya: Pattern: I confused its location between kitchen_table_k1 and dish_rack_k1. Reality: It stays on kitchen_table_k1 for most of the day. Next time: Default to kitchen_table_k1 unless there is specific evidence of washing.

razor_priya: Pattern: I defaulted to sink_ba_ba1. Reality: It consistently rests on bathroom_shelf_ba1. Next time: Always check bathroom_shelf_ba1 first.

General Note: Items like mug_priya and glass_priya show high mobility between kitchen and living areas. Do not assume static positions or bedroom movement without evidence. Prioritize checking kitchen_table_k1, counter_k1, and coffee_table_l1 based on the time of day.
